verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's webhook docs list "monitor check" events alongside crawl and scrape jobs, so a monitoring feature exists and can push notifications to an HTTPS endpoint, with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. However, the pack never describes how monitors detect content changes (diffing, field-level price or listing tracking) or how checks are scheduled. Missing for 10: documented change-detection or diff semantics, scheduling and frequency configuration, change-specific notification payloads, independent or hands-on corroboration.
